Jum e-SIM · Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

Last updated October 7, 2026

Who we are

Jum e-SIM is operated by the Jum e-SIM team.

What we collect

  • Your email — to deliver your eSIM, receipts, and instructions.
  • Purchase history — plans bought, top-ups, and refunds.
  • Device info — OS, model, and app version, used for troubleshooting only.
  • Support chat transcripts — so we can resolve your issue and follow up.

What we never do

We do not collect your location, contacts, photos, or browsing data, and we never sell data or share it with advertisers.

Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe — credit/debit cards and, where your device supports them, Apple Pay and Google Pay. We never see or store full card numbers.

Connectivity

eSIM connectivity is provided by eSIM Go. Your device contacts their servers during eSIM setup.

How we use your data

We use your data to deliver your eSIM, provide support, send service emails, and improve the app.

Your rights

Email support@jumesim.com to access, correct, export, or delete your data. GDPR rights are honored with a 30-day response time.

Retention

Purchase records are kept 7 years for accounting. Chat transcripts are kept 12 months.

Security

Data is encrypted in transit and at rest.

Questions about this policy? Email support@jumesim.com
